baseline.detail: JWT access/refresh behaviour is unchanged; invitation, settings, role and workspace routes are guarded.
RolesGuard and capability checks remain on settings, role and workspace routes.
app.use(helmet()) remains applied globally in server/src/main.ts.
The global ThrottlerGuard remains registered; new routes inherit the limit.
The global ValidationPipe uses whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted and transform; new DTOs are validated.
Prisma parameterises the new queries; no new raw SQL or unsafe concatenation.
React escapes rendered values and mail templates escape every interpolation; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
The refresh token remains an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; new mutations are POST/PATCH.
.env remains git-ignored; server/.env.example documents new keys by name only.
